## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Utilities). Confirmations: sector breadth ≤4/11 and both Financials and Industrials negative, with defensive leadership limited to pockets (JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.81%)).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%). Materials showing stock-level strength: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%), APD RECOVERY (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%). Technology pockets of momentum: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%), LRCX RECOVERY (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%). 

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials weak: WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%). Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN CORRECTION (1W: -2.60% | 1M: +1.76%), TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -8.66%). Technology broad weakness despite pockets: ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -3.05%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.28% | 1M: -1.96%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%), LRCX RECOVERY (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%), APD RECOVERY (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +5.41% | 1M: -5.22%). Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5) — not broad, watch concentration in Energy/Materials/Tech.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: GE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -4.34%), TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), KHC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.99% | 1M: -8.13%). Weakness concentrated in Industrials/Healthcare/Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) and OXY (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%) with clear momentum; AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%) also notable. Major divergence present (NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +1.33% | 1M: -2.72%), LRCX RECOVERY) — this MAJOR divergence suggests tactical uncertainty and to watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed, leaning weak with short-term bounces: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -9.21%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.28% | 1M: -1.96%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%). Sector shows internal rotations and divergences rather than broad leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Weak and under pressure: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -3.22% | 1M: -6.71%). Breadth and price action confirm Financials are a source of downside risk this week.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive names mixed: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.81%) is a relative safe-haven while SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%) and TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%) show pockets of stress; overall Healthcare is weak on the week.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor quality defensives and select Energy exposure (XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%), JNJ ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to broad Financials and high-beta Technology names showing breakdown (MSFT BELOW TREND, ADBE BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Defensive bias given RISK-OFF and narrow sector participation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%) — monitor follow-through. BEARISH: ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -3.05%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.18% | 1M: -11.16%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (sector up this week, leaders ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Financials and Industrials (both negative on the week and contributors to the RISK-OFF regime).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA RECOVERY: needs sustained 1M improvement to confirm re-acceleration; AAPL BELOW TREND: watch for continued 1M weakness to signal trend confirmation; XOM/CVX ABOVE TREND: sustained outperformance vs peers to signal safe-haven rotation; WFC BELOW TREND: further 1W weakness would deepen Financials downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+75): FDA approval headline confirms price action — JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.81%) — sentiment confirmed. NVDA (+50): AI GPU purchase headline aligns with short-term bounce — NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%) — accumulation signal. GOOGL (+50): YouTube strength headline supports GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +1.33% | 1M: -2.72%) — follow-through needed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
SYK (-55): cyberattack headwind matches price decline — SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%) — sentiment confirmed. INTU (-55): weak guidance headline aligns with pullback — INTU CORRECTION (1W: -8.56% | 1M: +10.08%) — monitor for further weakness. META (-50): layoff/AI cost headlines confirm downside — META BELOW TREND (1W: -4.83% | 1M: -8.22%).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Defensive bias. XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%) and DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among big Tech (NVDA RECOVERY, GOOGL RECOVERY, LRCX RECOVERY) plus weak Financials/Industrials — watch for trend breaks and news-confirmed distribution.
